meta.source_data_tree_note: git tree id of data/ when generated; equals `git rev-parse <commit>:data` for any commit with the same data
assumptions: rules from DamagePipeline §4-§7 only, through _tools/damage_tables.py: every selected entry multiplies the running amount, the total is clamped at 0 (§6)

§7.7 event: hostile alignment, FMJ (no ammo-modifier tag), a direct hit with no ricochet or penetration, no instigator tags, target outside any vehicle; point blank unless a falloff point says otherwise
armor: only the piece whose CoveredHitLocations holds the hit location reaches the rules (Auth_GetArmorDamageEvent, §7.6); every durability stage has the same R in the data (§7.5)
an absent cooked property is its class default (bHasArmingDelay false)
bone factor U × W: U from row Universal, W from the first source-context tag naming a row or its direct parent, 1.0 with none (§7.1); Meta.Damage.Explosive.Drone is exempt
radial factors use the projectile's source tag, its DamageEntityData.Context and the radius tag only, with no hit location (radial-context, radial-hit-location are not traced)

not_traced.text: How the hit bone becomes the event's hit-location tag: exact bone name only, a walk up the skeleton's parent bones, or a default for an unmapped bone. DamagePipeline §7.6 says only that the tag is "derived from the hit bone"; VehicleDamagePipeline V-2 says 0x6EF8DE0 fills an empty hit-location tag from ClassToHitLocations by bone name (0x6F01BB0), inside the branch taken when the event's target tag is None. GameMechanics §2b lists the map without the rule.
not_traced.data: DamageHitLocations maps 22 bone names to 12 tags (data/Wardogs/Content/GameMechanics/DamageSystem/HitLocationDataAssets/DA_GlobalDamage_HitLocations_Player.json).

not_traced.text: When DamageImpactRemap applies: before the bone lookup (changing the damage hit location) or only for impact effects. GameMechanics §2b lists the entries; no doc traces a reader.
not_traced.data: DamageImpactRemap: spine_01 → pelvis, spine_05 → spine_04. Applied before the lookup, spine_01 would read Pelvis instead of Torso.Lower and spine_05 Torso.Middle instead of Torso.Upper.

not_traced.text: What a hit on a body whose bone has no map entry gets. If no hit-location tag results, §4 rule 4 drops every entry with a hit-location filter (among them 5, 6, 7, 10 and 138–143) and §7.6 removes all armor tags, but whether such a hit gets no tag, a parent's tag or a default is the bone-lookup question.
not_traced.data: Only the bones in DamageHitLocations carry a tag in the data.

not_traced.text: The radial path (0x6F06540, §1.1): which DamageValues field is the starting amount, how damage falls off with distance, and which radius separates Meta.Damage.Explosive.Radius.Inner from .Outer. GameMechanics §14 says BaseDamage and ExplosiveRadius feed the Calibre rules and falloff is ExplosiveDamageFallOff, without a formula.
not_traced.data: Projectile assets carry BaseDamage, ExplosiveRadius, EffectiveExplosiveRadius, ExplosiveDamageFallOff and on some MinimumExplosiveDamage and ExplosiveBluntDamage (values per source below).

not_traced.text: How one explosion's damage lands on a character: once per character, per overlapped body or per traced hit, and from which point the distance is measured. VehicleDamagePipeline §3.2 traces the radial gather (0x6EFFDC0) for vehicles only: one Visibility line trace per overlapped component.
not_traced.data: No data field describes the split.

not_traced.text: Whether a radial event carries an infantry hit location. VehicleDamagePipeline §4.1 says the rule's hit-location tag comes from each hit (0x6F06540) for vehicles; DamagePipeline is silent for characters. With a tag, a bone entry whose source matches (5 Bullet, 10 Cannon) and the hit-location-filtered armor entries could select; without one they cannot (§4 rule 4).
not_traced.data: Rule entries 108–116 key on Radius.Inner / .Outer and have no hit-location filter.

not_traced.text: Which tags the radial event's source context carries besides the projectile's source tag and the radius tag (weapon tag, caliber id, ExplosiveBlunt). The radial factors here use the source tag, the projectile's DamageEntityData.Context and the radius tag only.
not_traced.data: Entries 108–116 need only the source tag and a radius tag.

not_traced.text: When a projectile hit is bExploding. §7.6: an exploding hit skips both scales, the armor hook and ModifyDamage on the projectile path; what sets bExploding is not stated. So whether an armed launcher or cannon round ever deals the direct-hit amount is open.
not_traced.data: Projectile assets carry bHasArmingDelay and ArmingDelay (seconds of flight time, §7.6).

not_traced.text: Grenade, C4, mine, claymore, IED and Molotov damage: the explosive-actor path (0x6CA8730, §1.1) is named, but its amount, source tags and hit location are not traced.
not_traced.data: The items reference actor Blueprints (B_FragGrenade, B_ThrowableC4, B_AT_Mine, B_Claymore, B_Molotov) that are not in the data export, so no damage value is in data/.

not_traced.text: Whether the target hook Auth_GetArmorDamageEvent (§7.6) runs on paths other than the projectile path (radial, explosive actors, melee, impact). It decides whether an armor tag reaches entries 102–106, 138–144.
not_traced.data: Armor items list CoveredHitLocations (see armor).

not_traced.text: Whether DT_GlobalDamage_ArmorData's rows are evaluated for a character hit. §5's walk for a character starts at Meta.Damage.Infantry and gives one group; the armor rows are keyed by armor tags.
not_traced.data: DT_GlobalDamage_ArmorData has rows Meta.Damage.Armor, Meta.Damage.Helmet and the two Ghillie rows.

not_traced.text: Whether a vehicle weapon extension (WE_*) puts its DamageEntityData.Tag into the source context as a weapon item does. §7.6 identifies the weapon tag by value for weapon items; the vehicle rows of BoneDamageModifiers are only reached if it does.
not_traced.data: Every WE_* file carries a Meta.Damage.Weapon.* tag (values per source).

not_traced.text: Which weapon tag an underbarrel grenade launcher shot carries.
not_traced.data: GrenadeLauncher.json has no Meta.Damage.Weapon tag; its stats are DA_GrenadeLauncher_Stats.

not_traced.text: The melee caller: §1.1 names no melee path, so the event's source (the item's Utility tag, whether Meta.Damage.DamageType.Melee is added), its hit location and the armor hook are not traced.
not_traced.data: Melee items carry WDItemExtensionData_CharacterMelee.MeleeActions[].Damage and DamageEntityData.Tag; entry 144 requires Meta.Damage.DamageType.Melee; BoneDamageModifiers has a Meta.Damage.DamageType.Melee row that no bone entry (5, 7, 10) selects for a melee-only source.

not_traced.text: Actor impact (0x6E72D90, §1.1): the starting amount and what the hitting actor's entity data holds (for a vehicle running a character over, or a thrown object).
not_traced.data: No infantry rule entry requires Meta.Damage.DamageType.Impact.

not_traced.text: Back-blast (0x6F06EB0 / 0x6F042A0 from 0x6B92900, §1.1): the event's source tag and amount, and which branch runs (O-8).
not_traced.data: Launcher stats carry a BackBlast config (FWDBackBlastConfig) whose field names are hashed in the export and the SDK; no infantry rule entry requires Meta.Damage.DamageType.BackBlast.

not_traced.text: Damage to vehicle occupants from UWDVehicleOperatorComponent slots 160/161 (§1.1; VehicleDamagePipeline §1): the amount and hit location.
not_traced.data: Source tags Meta.Damage.Explosive.VehicleExplosion + DamageType.Explosive, and Meta.Damage.Vehicle + DamageType.Enviroment.

not_traced.text: Whether Mutable merges the helmet physics assets into the character's runtime physics asset, which would add a helmet body on head. No doc traces it, so the model shows PA_TPCharacter_Simplified only.
not_traced.data: MUT_TP_Character lists five helmet physics assets (PA_Helmet_*), each with one body on head (assets/models/infantry/player.glb asset.extras.notes; MUT_TP_Character is not in the data/ JSON export).

not_traced.text: Which trace channels hit the character's bodies. The CharacterMesh component uses collision profile Custom, whose per-channel responses are native class defaults, not stored in the cooked Blueprint.
not_traced.data: CharacterMesh.BodyInstance.CollisionEnabled is QueryOnly (profile Custom); every body is QueryAndPhysics with BodyCollision_Enabled (assets/models/infantry/player.glb asset.extras.notes and node extras).

not_traced.text: Data only, no documented use: no doc uses a body's physical material or surface type for infantry damage (VFX uses physical materials for impact effects; VehicleDamagePipeline §3.2 says vehicle hits read neither physical materials nor bone names).
not_traced.data: The head body uses PM_Head, the other 19 bodies PM_Body (assets/models/infantry/player.glb asset.extras.bodies[].phys_material; the body export gives SurfaceType17 and SurfaceType3; the PM_* assets are not in the data/ JSON export).

not_traced.text: Whether a weapon whose SupportedCaliber is a parent tag fires the child projectiles: the bow lists Item.Caliber.Arrow (child Arrow.Explosive), the M500 / MP43 Item.Caliber.12g (child 12g.RifledSlug), the artillery Item.Caliber.155mm (155mm.Standard, .Expensive), STN_03 Item.Caliber.120x800mm (120x800mm.Standard). How SupportedCaliber is matched is not traced.
not_traced.data: No WDProjectileData asset has ProjectileId Item.Caliber.12g, .155mm or .120x800mm; the child ids each have one (Sandbox copies left out).

categories.label: Bullets
categories.note: One event per hit from the projectile data and the firing weapon (§7.6): S = BaseDamage × speed scale × distance curve. Entry 5 multiplies by Universal × weapon row for the hit location (§7.1); a covering helmet or armor piece adds entries 138/140 (§7.3).

categories.label: Explosives and launchers
categories.note: Launcher, cannon and shell rounds hit through the same projectile path. Before arming, S is ExplosiveBluntDamage and the source carries Kinetic.Impact.ExplosiveBlunt, so entry 7 applies the bone factor and entries 142–143 armor durability. Cannon rounds take entry 10. An exploding hit skips ModifyDamage there (§7.6); the blast goes through the radial path (§1.1) with Radius.Inner or .Outer. How the blast amount is computed and split over a body is not traced. Grenades, C4 and mines use the explosive-actor path, whose values are not in the export.

categories.label: Other
categories.note: Melee and impact events match no bone entry (5, 7, 10 need Bullet, ExplosiveBlunt or Cannon, §3.1), so the factor is the same on every hit location. Entry 144 reduces melee damage on an armored target by R (§7.5).

model.centres_note: world-space bounding-box centre of each body's mesh, metres, glTF axes (+Y up, facing +Z, origin at the feet), from accessor min/max through the composed node transforms
notes: Hit-trace bodies: PA_TPCharacter_Simplified is the PhysicsAsset of SK_DefaultCharacter (B_WDMoverPlayerCharacter CharacterMesh.SkeletalMesh) and of SK_TP_Male_000, the reference mesh of MUT_TP_Character that builds the runtime mesh. CharacterMesh.BodyInstance.CollisionEnabled is QueryOnly (profile Custom).
Ragdoll uses a different asset: DA_WDRagdollMovement.PhysicsAsset is PA_TPCharacter_Simplified_Physics. It is not shown here.
Reference pose of SK_DefaultCharacter; in game the bodies follow the animated bones.
Origin at the feet (mesh component origin); the actor origin is 0.96 m higher. Facing +Z.

Helmets: MUT_TP_Character also lists five helmet physics assets (PA_Helmet_*), each with one body on head. Whether Mutable merges them into the runtime physics asset is not visible in the cooked data; they are not shown.

direct.label: Before arming (flight time below ArmingDelay): S = ExplosiveBluntDamage
Direct hit that is not exploding: S = BaseDamage (when a hit explodes is not traced)

sources.label: Fists
sources.why: No bone entry matches a melee source (entries 5, 7, 10 need Bullet, ExplosiveBlunt or Cannon, §3.1), so the body takes the same factor everywhere. Entry 144 applies armor durability (1 − R/100, §7.5) to an armored target if the DamageType.Melee tag and the armor tag reach the event, which is not traced.
